lattice.status: provisional local well: absolute Pd spectrum fails

positive_control.type: measured optical INS band; peak position, not linewidth
positive_control.material_phase_loading: bulk polycrystalline textured fcc NiH with octahedral H; hot-extracted H/Ni = 1.05 +/- 0.05
positive_control.mode_wavevector_polarization: first optical H band; measured incoherent INS spectrum, not a single resolved crystal wavevector; paper usually assigns main peak to weakly dispersed transverse optic modes and shoulder to longitudinal modes
positive_control.observed: main band peak at 89 meV, with high-energy shoulder to about 130 meV; 89 meV is the peak energy, not an FWHM, HWHM or lifetime
positive_control.instrument_resolution: IN1 Be-filter neutron spectrometer, reported relative energy resolution 6–8% over the measurement range; this is instrument resolution, not intrinsic linewidth; no target-mode resolution-deconvolved homogeneous damping reported in the source
positive_control.source: V. E. Antonov et al., Europhys. Lett. 51, 140–146 (2000), pp. 142–143, Results and Fig. 2: http://www.issp.ac.ru/lhpp/PapersAntonov/127.pdf

measured_rows.why_not_eligible: The reported first-band position, spread and instrument resolution cannot determine a homogeneous single-mode linewidth or lifetime. Peak and shoulder combine q/mode dispersion and the paper does not supply a separated lifetime.

positive_control.type: measured Gaussian component width of an incoherent optic band, NOT a homogeneous mode linewidth
positive_control.material_phase_loading: bulk fcc beta PdH0.99 +/- 0.03, powder and textured plates; H in octahedral interstices
positive_control.mode_wavevector_polarization: multiphonon-corrected first optical band; powder/plate incoherent spectral distribution, no single q; main component predominantly associated with transverse modes rather than an isolated q-resolved mode
positive_control.observed: Gaussian peak position 55.8 meV with Gaussian FWHM 4.8 meV, fitted as one component of a three-Gaussian band
positive_control.instrument_resolution: TFXA at ISIS; paper reports about 2–3% relative energy resolution. Multiphonon contributions were iteratively subtracted, which is NOT an instrumental resolution deconvolution or removal of dispersion. No intrinsic-mode Lorentzian width or lifetime is extracted.
positive_control.source: D. K. Ross et al., Phys. Rev. B 58, 2591–2595 (1998), pp. 2591–2592, Secs. II–III, Fig. 2 and Table I: http://www.issp.ac.ru/lhpp/PapersAntonov/116.pdf

measured_rows.why_not_eligible: 4.8 meV is a Gaussian band-fit FWHM, not a measured homogeneous Lorentzian FWHM. Phonon dispersion and instrument response are not disentangled; do not convert this raw band width to kappa.

positive_control.type: measured bulk powder optic spectrum; matrix spectrum extracted by isotope-mixture analysis, not intrinsic linewidth
positive_control.material_phase_loading: bulk fcc PdD(1-x)H(x), total (D+H)/Pd = 1.00 +/- 0.03; isotope fractions x = 0.050, 0.072, 0.091. The reported undisturbed-PdD spectrum is extracted from mixtures, not a direct isotopically pure PdD sample.
positive_control.mode_wavevector_polarization: optical D band integrated over powder scattering; no single q or polarization assigned to the quoted maximum
positive_control.observed: first optic band has a maximum at 37 meV and a shoulder extending to about 65 meV; neither 37 meV nor the shoulder span is FWHM, HWHM or lifetime
positive_control.instrument_resolution: IN1-BeF, reported energy-transfer resolution 5–8% for 30–180 meV. Mixture decomposition separates a modeled impurity contribution; it does not resolve q or provide homogeneous/instrument-deconvolved mode damping.
positive_control.source: V. E. Antonov et al., Phys. Rev. B 80, 134302 (2009), pp. 134302-1–4, Secs. II–III and Figs. 1–5: http://www.issp.ac.ru/lhpp/PapersAntonov/163.pdf

independent_line_shape_evidence.material_conditions: single-crystal PdD0.63 at 80 K, coherent inelastic neutron scattering, optical phonon line shapes
independent_line_shape_evidence.finding: Authors report substantial broadening and subsidiary structure and attribute predominant broadening to nonstoichiometry based on comparison to a disorder model. This is evidence against silently interpreting the complex line as homogeneous lifetime loss. Specific q, numerical widths, instrument deconvolution and tables are unavailable from the author abstract read; full text returned HTTP 401.
independent_line_shape_evidence.source: C. J. Glinka et al., Phys. Rev. B 17, 488 (1978), author abstract: https://journals.aps.org/prb/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevB.17.488

measured_rows.why_not_eligible: The near-stoichiometric PdD matrix result is a q-integrated band, while the mode-resolved PdD0.63 line shape contains substantial nonstoichiometric structure; neither available source gives a matching isolated homogeneous loss value. Neither may be replaced by a PdH number.

optical_loss.width_ceiling_assumption: Only IF selected-mode homogeneous Lorentzian FWHM is <= fitted PdH Gaussian-band-component4.8meV. The source does not establish this identification or a universal mode-wise bound. No numeric NiH/PdD lifetime bound follows from quoted energies/resolution.
